candidates.name: armin-one-lead-support-layers
candidates.summary: One lead carries the track, dry and centered; all other layers (doubled synths, reverb tails, vocal stacks) exist only to support it. Toggle test: without support layers the track loses its soul, with them the lead pierces at its peak. Sessions run to 110 channels; a piano recording becomes a 75-layer club track; quantizing to the grid costs human feel but makes layering at scale possible.
